title: Canonical chart structural map to the strict henselization
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme, $M$ a log structure on $X$ as in [def-trf-fs-log-blowup], and $x:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to X$ a geometric point [def-weil-geometric-point]. Let $W\to X$ be an etale neighbourhood with a lift $w$ of $x$. For any additive commutative monoid $P$ and monoid homomorphism $c:P\to M(W)$, define its strict-henselization structural map $a_{x,W,w,c}:P\to B_x$, where $B_x=\mathcal O^{\mathrm{sh}}_{X,x}$ is the affine pointed-neighbourhood colimit [def-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-limit], to be the composite $P\xrightarrow{c}M(W)\xrightarrow{\mathrm{germ}_{x,W,w}}M_x\xrightarrow{\alpha_x}\mathcal O_{X_{\mathrm{et}},x}\xrightarrow{\iota_x}B_x$. Here the stalks and germs are the colimits of [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks], and $\iota_x$ is the canonical ring isomorphism induced by restricting the pointed-neighbourhood colimit to affine neighbourhoods and passing to its chosen small model. Include this canonical isomorphism as part of the construction. No chart, finiteness, sharpness or log-regularity hypothesis is needed to define the composite; for a chart $c$ it is its structural map on the strict local ring.
